name: Know Your Ship
description: ARIA shows you round the Aqua Nova.

objectives.description: Open the logbook on your desk (your quarters)
Open your PED (top-right corner) and read your tasks
Leave your quarters for the walkway
Walk to the bridge, the door at the end of the walkway

onStart.text: {captain}, before we take her out, a short tour of the ship. Anything you have already done, I have already noted. The walkway and the bridge are the rest.

onComplete.text: That is the ship, Captain. The helm and systems are signed off. You can also ask Marcus to move the ship on the communicator. OERA will send your orders soon.

message.subject: Commissioning orders
message.text:
{captain},

Thank you for answering the call at such short notice. The Alliance is aware of the circumstances of Captain Voss's departure, and we are grateful for your steadiness.

Your first task is to commission the Aqua Nova with a series of system tests. You are to depart immediately for the Area of Operations (AO), a box on the edge of the continental shelf about 100 nm south of Woods Hole: 39°45'N to 40°03'N, 070°45'W to 071°15'W. It is drawn on your chart as the Trials AO. En route, do not exceed 15 knots or 300 meters.

In the AO you will test her depth and speed. Your orders for the trials will be waiting when you arrive.

ARIA has the full trials checklist. It is a long transit: she can take the con while you rest. Accept these orders in Comms and get underway.

Admiral Catherine Okafor
Director of Operations, O.E.R.A.

hints.message: Your logbook is the laptop on the desk, {captain}. It holds your orders.
Your PED was on the bed. Once you have it, its button is at the top of the screen.
The bridge is the door at the end of the main walkway, {captain}.
